generated_evidence.quote_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved. generated_evidence.full_source_line_en: Eight primary screens each require one primary action and status summary. Draft labels use accessible `DRAFT`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, `PUBLISHED`, not color alone. Meaningful-only announcements, visible focus/semantic regions/keyboard order and WCAG2.2AA target apply. Server UTC presents workspace-local labeled time; locale never changes durable API/order.
